caption: This is the healthy low sugar pancake recipe that converted my picky eater 🥞✨ These fluffy almond milk pancakes are the one breakfast my kids actually get excited about and they have NO idea they’re dairy-free and healthy! Made with unsweetened almond milk instead of regular milk, and minimal added sugar, they come out just as soft, fluffy, and golden as the classic version. Ready in 35 minutes, one blender, 10 pancakes. My secret tip: let the batter rest for 10 minutes before you cook. that’s the whole trick for getting that airy texture. Ingredients - 1¼ cups (150g) all-purpose flour use a gluten-free flour blend or oat flour for a gf option - 2 tsp baking powder - 1/4 cup coconut sugar - 1 cup (237ml) unsweetened almond milk - 1 room temperature egg can use a flax egg for a vegan option - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 1/4 cup (57g) butter, melted can use vegan butter for a vegan option Instructions 1. Add all ingredients to a high-speed blender and blend until smooth. 2. Remove and allow the batter to rest for 10 minutes. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat, drop ¼ cup of batter into the skillet and cook until small bubbles appear. 4. Flip and continue to cook for another 3-4 minutes. 5. Remove and repeat until all batter has been used up. The batter makes about 10 pancakes. 6. Serve pancakes with your favorite pancake toppings. save this for your next slow weekend morning and share with a fellow mom who needs to try this!
